_comment: PREPROD deployment template for the ShaSwap reference solver, pinned to the LIVE Rev 25 clearing-price-pin deployment (reference scripts in tx 9088f8dc…, canonical TEST/ADA pool reseeded in tx 255040ab…). Unlike the mainnet template this is FULLY FILLED — every identity below is already on-chain on preprod — so an operator only needs to (1) point kupo_url/ogmios_url at their own preprod node and (2) set signing_key_path to their own preprod solver key. Copy to deployment.preprod.json and run. The four script hashes (settlement/order/pool/lp_intent) + nft_name / lp_name / total_lp / min_liq / *_min_ada match contracts/plutus.json + constants.ak.
_provider: Point at your OWN preprod node (Kupo + Ogmios, or Dolos) for a no-third-party-dependency setup. Localhost shown; replace with your endpoints. Kupo MUST index the lp_intent ENTERPRISE address (it is NOT S-tagged) or the batcher never sees LP intents.
_pool_mint_policy: PER-POOL: each pool's one-shot NFT/LP minting policy is derived from its seed OutputReference, so this is the policy id of the SPECIFIC pool this batcher serves (the batcher discovers pools by pool_mint_policy + nft_name). d5ccd174… below is the LIVE canonical preprod TEST/ADA pool (tx 255040ab…). Change it to serve a different preprod pool.
_refs: The LIVE Rev 25 reference-script deploy tx (settlement #0, pool #1, order #2, lp_intent #3). lp_intent_ref is REQUIRED for the batcher to fulfil LP intents (Rev 22); omit it only to run settlements-only.
_skey: cardano-cli TextEnvelope signing key for YOUR preprod solver wallet. File mode 0600, OUTSIDE the repo. Controls only the solver's own float, never user funds.
